conbody.p: On a computer, click a card to open it beside the board: the board gives it room and stays in view, so you can go from card to card. The open mark at a card's corner, or in the open card's header, opens the card in full, wide in the middle of the window. On a phone a card opens over the board. Either way the card lets you:

ul.li: See linked artifacts (from the artifact IDs) with links into the Requirements view.

Follow its History — comments, moves, status changes, and agent run events — and add your own comments. It is the same History an artifact has: Comments, Changes and All choose what it lists, and with the card opened in full it is a card of its own.

conbody.p: Opened in full on a computer, the card also shows everything the plan holds on it, on the right: its schedule (start, due date, duration, effort and deadline), the task it is a sub-task of, who is assigned and what has been done, its milestone, its relationships with other tasks, its to-dos and its sub-tasks. It is the same panel the Gantt page shows for the task, and a change made in either place shows in both: see The plan (Gantt). Selecting a sub-task or a related task there opens that card.
